messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — starting Wed Apr 6 we'll migrate repo CI secrets into Vault and enable OIDC short-lived tokens for GitHub Actions and our self-hosted runners. This will deprecate repo-level secrets and long-lived PATs for CI. Full plan & opt-out list: https://go/redwood/ci-vault-oidc (doc PR incoming)

Kevin: ETA on enforcement? Any expected downtime or CI flakiness?

Maya: No infra downtime expected. Proposed enforcement windows: Apr 6–12 (canary), Apr 13 enforcement for non-canary repos. Canary targets: infra/*, core-services/* first. We'll post updates to #eng-oncall during the canary.

devex-bot: Checklist created: https://go/redwood/checklists/ci-vault-migration — add your repo by commenting `add: <repo>` in that doc.

Sarah: Reminder: org admins need to enable OIDC trust in org settings and add the role mapping step in the repo. I'll DM the exact instructions to org admins and owners.

Ops-Ryan: How will service accounts (k8s jobs, deploy bots) authenticate? They currently use long-lived tokens embedded in CI.

Maya: Good question. We'll issue short-lived machine identities via our OIDC broker. For k8s jobs we provide a helper and recommend annotating SAs. Example:
```
# annotate SA for AWS IRSA
kubectl annotate serviceaccount deploy-bot eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn=arn:aws:iam::123456:role/ci-deploy
```
We'll also publish a small operator to refresh creds for long-running processes.

Alex: Our repo uses a 3rd-party action that expects a PAT stored in secrets. GITHUB_TOKEN won't suffice for that action today — what's the migration path?

Kevin: For actions that absolutely need PATs we'll create org-scoped fine-grained tokens issued by the broker as a temporary compatibility measure. Please list any such actions in the checklist doc so we can scope exceptions.

PM_Lia: Product freeze next week — can we exclude release/* repos from the canary until the freeze ends?

Maya: Yes — we'll exclude release/* from the Apr 6 canary. PM_Lia DM me the exact repo names you want held.

Alex: Any changes required for local dev workflows? I run `gh auth login` and some pushes trigger workflows that read secrets.

Maya: Local dev: nothing breaks for normal `gh` auth. If you run workflows locally that access CI secrets, install `ci-vault-cli` (brew or tarball) and run `ci-vault-cli login`. We'll add a short migration README to repos that need it.

Kevin: Ops note: we'll rotate all existing tokens on Apr 20. Please remove any embedded tokens in code — quick scan: `git grep -n "GITHUB_PAT" || true`. If you find anything, open an infra ticket so we can help.

Alex: ack — running the grep now.

Sarah: Security FYI: after enforcement, CI logs will redact full token-like patterns. If you spot sensitive values in logs or PRs, please escalate to security immediately.

Maya: Action items:
- Add your repo to the checklist (devex-bot link)
- Org admins enable OIDC trust and role mappings (Sarah)
- File list of 3rd-party actions requiring PATs (Kevin)
- Ops schedule token rotations and helper rollout (Kevin/Ryan)
I'll post daily progress notes during the canary and a final post before org-wide enforcement.

Kevin: thanks — ping me if you want help with the repo sweep.

PM_Lia: Thanks Maya. :thumbsup:

devex-bot: Migration status updated: canaries scheduled Apr 6; next update Apr 7 09:00 PDT.
